explication: EdgeVPN is a Go application and embeddable library for forming decentralized private networks over libp2p, with VPN, DNS, service tunneling, file transfer, and a shared ledger. The main workflow is: a user supplies a shared network configuration or token, starts a node, and the node discovers peers and exchanges ledger-backed state; configured services then provide VPN connectivity or other peer-to-peer features. The optional local API and React dashboard expose network status and ledger data. CLI startup wiring is sampled; feature-level links beyond those shown are limited to documented capabilities and repository structure.
